collections.name: Local Icons
collections.blurb: One small icon per beach town, stitched or printed on crewnecks, tees and caps. Quiet marks, never big lettering.

collections.name: Locals' Christmas
collections.blurb: Christmas on the Carolina coast. Gifts and stocking stuffers for Wilmington locals and everyone who wishes they were at the beach.

collections.name: Landmark Prints
collections.blurb: The fishing piers, the Carolina Beach boardwalk and the battleship as vintage travel posters on museum-matte paper. Wall art, not clothing.

collections.name: Coastal Classics
collections.blurb: The pennant cap and the pennant tee in quiet coastal colors, each with one small, understated mark.

collections.name: Tide Line
collections.blurb: Organic cotton totes for the boat, the beach and the market run.

collections.name: Shore Gear
collections.blurb: A market tote and town can coolers.

collections.name: Harbor Capsules
collections.blurb: Themed capsule sets, made to order.

collections.name: Beach Setup
collections.blurb: The chair, the shade, the towel and the cooler. Everything for a full day on Wrightsville, Carolina Beach or Kure.

shelves.name: Wrightsville Beach
shelves.blurb: The sloop is our Wrightsville Beach mark, printed as a navy pattern on a tote, mug, pillow, pouch, tea towel and pet bandana, with a can cooler and a stitched cap and crewneck.

shelves.name: Carolina Beach
shelves.tag: The lifeguard stand on the sand
shelves.blurb: The lifeguard stand is our Carolina Beach mark, stitched small on a white crewneck and printed on a tee, mug, pouch and pillow, with a stitched pelican crewneck, cap and beanie and a can cooler.

shelves.name: Kure Beach
shelves.blurb: The lifeguard stand is our Kure Beach mark, stitched small on a white crewneck and printed on a tee, tote, mug, pouch and pillow, with a stitched blue crab crewneck and a can cooler.

shelves.name: Wilmington and the Coast
shelves.blurb: Pieces that belong to the whole coast: the Airlie Oak tote, the Live Oak embroidered crewneck and the Carolina Coast beach towel.

item_fields: id, collection, name, url (https product page on one of the stores[] hosts), img, alt, meta, cta, price (number, USD, lowest variant price), from (optional boolean, true when the price varies by option so the page prints From $X), scenes[] (beach|boardwalk|riverwalk|harbor-night), cut (optional, unisex), store (shopify|fourthwall), buy (optional https cart permalink for one-tap checkout), shelf (optional presentation field: id from shelves[], used by the collection-first shop page), studio (optional product shot url, shown as a second image in quick view), lookbook (styled image url), facts (optional [[label, text], ...] rows shown in quick view; only facts stated in the product listing or the maker's spec, never marketing claims), blank (optional, internal only: supplier blank brand and model, never rendered on the page)

stores.name: ShoreList Shop
stores.carries: Embroidered and varsity apparel, beach gear, can coolers and ornaments

stores_note: Both stores are live: the Shopify store carries the embroidered and varsity apparel, beach gear, can coolers and ornaments and feeds the on-site bag; the second store carries the art prints, printed tees, two crewnecks, totes and the dad hat and checks out on its own site. The store links strip shows only when 2+ stores resolve to an allowed host. allowedHosts lists the exact store hosts (the page also accepts their subdomains); item url, buy and stores[].url are dropped by the page if their host is not listed. If the store domain changes (for example to shorelist.shop), update stores[].url, item urls, allowedHosts and the STORE constants in shop-cart.js and netlify/functions/shop-product.js together.

retired.note: Removed from the on-site shop on 2026-11-21 (shop-redo). The shop only renders items in items[], so retired products stop showing everywhere (shop page, Tidebot, llms digest). Shopify/Fourthwall listings are unchanged until unpublished in admin. See plans/shop-redo-spec.md.

shelves_note: The shop page groups items by town. item.town (or item.shelf, same ids) places an item on a town shelf; an item with neither is placed by its name (a town name in it) and otherwise lands on Wilmington and the Coast. New products need only a town id from shelves[]. type: tops|hats|prints|coolers|ornaments|beach (inferred from the name when missing). color is only set where the listing text states it. added is the date the item joined the shop and drives New arrivals. motif (optional): sea-life | boats-buoys | beach-scenes, set only when the art shows it; the page also matches words from motifs[].words in the item name. A motif with no pieces shows an on-the-way card, never a placeholder product.
